summaryZh: Benna 实验室研究生物大脑在资源受限条件下的学习与记忆计算，涉及突触可塑性、记忆巩固、持续学习和高效编码。团队分析神经活动记录，结合理论物理、应用数学、机器学习和数据科学建立可由实验数据检验的回路模型。
researchQuestions: 大脑如何克服资源限制以实现学习和记忆？

evidence.quote: We investigate open problems in computational neuroscience — especially concerning synaptic plasticity, memory consolidation, continual learning, representational geometry and efficient coding — using tools from theoretical physics, applied mathematics, machine learning and data science.

By constructing normative mathematical models of brain circuits, which can be tested on experimental data, we attempt to clarify how these limitations are overcome and uncover the underlying computational principles.
